questions.question: Which is not a swaging machine:

explanations.a: Tagging machines are a type of rotary swaging machine used for diameter reduction.
explanations.b: Cogging machines are primarily used for pre-forging large ingots, not for swaging operations.
explanations.c: Butt swaging machines are commonly used for forming tapered or reduced sections.
explanations.d: Incorrect because cogging is a forging operation, not swaging.

questions.question: Swaging technique involves removal of material:

explanations.a: Swaging reshapes metal without cutting, so material is not removed.
explanations.b: Swaging is a plastic deformation process where material flows without removal.

questions.question: The stresses involved in making of swaged part are generally compressive in nature:

explanations.a: Swaging applies radial compressive forces to plastically deform the workpiece.
explanations.b: Incorrect because swaging does not involve tensile stresses.

questions.question: The swaging process is generally carried out with the help of the two dies/punches:

explanations.a: Incorrect because swaging machines often use more than two dies.
explanations.b: Swaging is commonly performed using multiple dies acting radially.

explanations.a: Both terms describe forging processes where deformation occurs by radial die action.
explanations.b: Incorrect because rotary forging and radial forging refer to the same process.
